title: [Feature Request] Reduce verbosity in plan mode to minimize token consumption
body:
**Bug Description**
The new plan mode is too verbose. It basically tries to implement everything in the plan file, and it keeps asking the same questions repeatedly. One conversation already used 42% of my 5-hour quota.
Please optimize it to be more concise and natural.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.0.53
- Feedback ID: 33fcf8b5-b271-4305-886b-100a2039dba7

**Errors**
```json
[]
```
